title: Connect to a remote server with SFTP
summary: Open an interactive file transfer session with a remote computer over SSH. Once connected, you can browse and copy files between your computer and the server.

steps.explain: Start an SFTP session by specifying the remote username and host. You will be prompted for a password or use your SSH key.

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: IP address or domain name of the remote server

alternatives.explain: Connect to a specific port if the server does not use the default SSH port (22).

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: IP address or domain name of the remote server

alternatives.explain: Connect using a host alias defined in your SSH configuration file (~/.ssh/config).
